title: Progress bar
lead: The progress bar component is used to show the completion rate of a given task in the form of a filled bar where you can also add a label indicating percentage

prose.text:
Use the progress bar component from Flowbite React to show the percentage and completion rate of a given task using a visually friendly bar meter based on multiple styles and sizes.

Choose one of the examples below for your application and use the React props to update the progress fill rate, label, sizing, and colors and customize with the classes from Tailwind CSS.

To start using the progress bar component make sure you import it first from Flowbite React:

prose.title: Default progress bar
prose.text: Use this example to show a progress bar where you can set the progress rate using the `progress` prop from React which should be a number from 1 to 100.

prose.title: Progress bar with labels
prose.text: Use this example to show a progress bar with a label. You can set the label text using the `textLabel` prop and the progress text using the `labelText` prop.

prose.title: Label positioning
prose.text: This example shows how you can position the label text inside the progress bar by using the React props called `progressLabelPosition` and `textLabelPosition` on the `<Progress>` component in React.

prose.title: Sizing
prose.text: The `size` prop from React can be used on the `<Progress>` component to set the size of the progress bar. You can choose from `sm`, `md`, `lg` and `xl`.

prose.title: Colors
prose.text: Set your own custom colors for the progress bar component by using the `color` prop from React and the utility classes from Tailwind CSS.

prose.title: Theme
prose.text: To learn more about how to customize the appearance of components, please see the [Theme docs](/docs/customize/theme).

api.reason: 공식 문서에 정리된 표가 없어서, 설치된 패키지에 들어 있는 타입 정의에서 뽑았어요 (ADR-025). 이 컴포넌트가 물려받는 속성까지 함께 담았습니다. 설명과 기본값은 그 타입 정의에 달린 주석에서 가져온 것이라 공식 문서의 표현과 다를 수 있고, 기본값이 주석에 안 적힌 속성은 기본값 칸이 비어 있어요 — 기본값이 없다는 뜻은 아닙니다. 타입 정의에 없는 것(문서에만 있거나 실행 중에만 받는 값)은 여기 없어요.
